description.narrative:
The project evaluates Danish Institutes, Houses and Cultural Centres in developing countries with the aim of guiding future decision-making and management of potential future Danish Institutes in Sub-Saharan Africa.
The Danish Institutes aims are; to promote dialogue, foster professional and creative partnership on sustainable development in Egypt; to strengthen Ukrainian youth and their ability to organise and promote a democratic culture; to support locally anchored culture and arts in Palestine; and to promote research in the middle east.
The evaluation finds that the best ‘return of investment’ when it comes to the implementation of Danish Institutes and Cultural Centres, is a combination of culture and arts, youth engagement and human rights activities within the broader area of sustainable development as this can be linked to employment and economic empowerment locally.
